player_intent: Standing and crouched operators place each boot on the current stair tread without changing their weapon, shoulders, camera, or authoritative movement.
acceptance_rule: Two ground rays may drive only the left and right upper-leg, knee, and foot bones during ordinary grounded standing or crouched movement; fire recovery, reload, prone, airborne, and mobility actions disable the pass, while CharacterBody transform and velocity and every upper-body bone remain unchanged.

nodes.role: Samples the current tread below the animated left boot.
Samples the current tread below the animated right boot.
Consumes both contact targets after animation and writes only six declared leg bones.
Exposes the resolved left-foot contact to the canonical pose graph.
Exposes the resolved right-foot contact to the canonical pose graph.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D transform, velocity, collision, and traversal authority
SOCOM camera, reticle, and aim intent
server shot, damage, ballistics, and networking authority
spine, shoulders, arms, hands, weapon sockets, fire recovery, and reload
Skeleton3D process priority, modifier callback mode, and global engine timing
visual_check: Run res://main.tscn on stairs and confirm each boot reaches its tread while standing and crouched; both hands remain on the weapon, shoulders stay square during fire, and grounding disappears during fire recovery, reload, prone, jump, dive, and roll.
failure_lessons: SkeletonIK3D.stop clears global overrides for the whole Skeleton3D, so a foot solver must not use the shared legacy socket helper after hand and shoulder presentation.
A foot solver must not raise Skeleton3D process priority, add CopyTransform hand modifiers, alter Engine.physics_ticks_per_second, level the CharacterBody root, or own camera motion.
RayCast3D contact sampling is safe only when the result remains presentation data and the CharacterBody remains the sole collision and movement writer.

system_delta.reason: Keep the canonical animation and posture owners, reject the reference movement/camera/root-leveling code, and merge only its ray-to-contact idea through a bounded six-leg-bone modifier.

current.system: Previous native foot attempt with self-running modifiers, shared skeleton priority mutation, and deprecated SkeletonIK3D global-override clearing

candidate.system: Two bounded ground rays with one explicitly gated leg-only final modifier and upper-body/body invariance telemetry
